scope.basis: immutable local files named by the passing pre-create terminal

positive_findings.finding: The benchmark calls pinned vLLM quantize_weights and awq_pack, loads AWQ tensors through AWQMarlinLinearMethod, runs process_weights_after_loading, and times method.apply; runtime/source/H100 checks bind the selected Marlin kernel and wrapper.

Gaussian varied-sign weights and activations feed finite/nontrivial kernel and representation oracles from timed outputs. The sweep is six exact shapes at M8/M16/M32/M3679 with architecture multiplicities and separate cold W4/BF16 aggregation.

The primary archive and typed terminal are hash-checked and atomically persisted before the conditional stage. VerifiedRetainedOwner plus an independent watchdog provide named instance/disk cleanup with authenticated post-delete inventory checks.

material_findings.finding: The conditional script expands SESSION_STARTED_EPOCH under set -u, but build_container_command never supplies that environment variable.
material_findings.consequence: After sweep/profile work, the script deterministically exits before evaluating the adjacent trigger or writing stage-terminal.json. The conditional archive cannot satisfy the controller's typed retrieval contract, and the head arm cannot run under its named trigger.

material_findings.finding: Pre-create hashes local inputs, but after SCP no remote input file is hashed or compared with the expected digest. Only the returned result archive is remote/local hash-checked.
material_findings.consequence: A retrieved timing artifact cannot prove it was produced by the frozen benchmark, wrapper, contract, or head bytes named by pre-create.

material_findings.finding: The raw nvidia-smi stream has timestamps, but the program records no benchmark interval epochs, never differences timestamps to validate cadence, never proves coverage of scored intervals, and accepts the sentinel from two H100-name rows without an activity/liveness condition. The conditional terminal does not summarize telemetry at all.
material_findings.consequence: The paid brief's telemetry stop rule and interval/cadence interpretation cannot be evaluated from the typed terminals.

material_findings.finding: NCU requests the intended NVTX range and four metrics, but counters_pass is only the profiler process return code. CSV presence, required kernel rows, metric columns, finite values, and range capture are never parsed, and the overall conditional pass ignores counters_pass.
material_findings.consequence: No mechanism claim may be made from the profile flag; any raw CSV would require an independent content-bound evaluator.

material_findings.finding: The summary labels controller elapsed time from before provider create through cleanup as allocation exposure, while no typed total separates scored CUDA, warmup/comparator CUDA, profiling, and head time. The head pass also does not gate on its collected runtime/GPU/capability/consumer identity.
material_findings.consequence: Setup dominance, useful-GPU efficiency, provider exposure, cost, and any head floor are not acceptance-safe from this program.

interpretation_boundary.primary_sentinel: quarantine_scientific_timing; lifecycle and diagnostic existence only
interpretation_boundary.w4_sweep: quarantine_even_if_raw_rows_exist; conditional typed terminal is unreachable and remote bytes/telemetry are unbound
interpretation_boundary.ncu_profiles: quarantine; process return code is not counter evidence
interpretation_boundary.parallel_lm_head: no_result_permitted; named trigger is unreachable and identity is not acceptance-gated
interpretation_boundary.cleanup_and_cost: cleanup may be interpreted from cleanup.json; cost may be reported only as conservative controller-elapsed derived accounting, not measured provider exposure

portfolio_recommendation: Do not mutate or restart the live owner from this audit. Reconcile authenticated cleanup and conservative spend only; treat any scientific artifacts as descriptive diagnostics, not campaign evidence. This is a final-program failure, not evidence against W4/Marlin.
